visual_prompt: Create a React component displaying a document viewer. Non-compliant clauses (e.g., unlimited liability) are highlighted in yellow. Hovering triggers a popover showing the agent's suggested redline replacement.
A node graph component connecting a central legal situation to historical case precedents based on semantic similarity scores, visualized with interactive nodes.
A risk matrix plotting flagged clauses by severity and likelihood, auto-generated by the Legal Agent.

A glowing balance scale of justice with interactive compliance badges (⚖️ Legal Scale, 📜 Contract MSA, ⚠️ Unlimited Liability, ✅ Approved Redline, 🔍 Citation Grounding), allowing users to balance legal risks.
